decisions.reason: As a flagship product closely aligned with the firm's core dosimetry and QA capabilities, and with the firm expanding in a growing high-R&D industry, it is likely performing at or above aspiration and can be supported by organizational slack.

Because this software builds on the firm's established oncology QA offer and the firm has broad capabilities and expansion-related slack, there is no clear shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, though software is somewhat more uncertain than the core instrument line.
